english.title: Fail to forward service charge information request
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having received a service charge on behalf of **(..SPECIFY PERSON ENTITLED TO ENFORCE PAYMENT..), a person who was entitled to enforce payment of the said charge, failed without reasonable excuse to comply with a duty, imposed by section 48(5) of the Housing Act 1985, to forward to that person as soon as possible a request pursuant to section 48(1) or (4) made by **(..SPECIFY PERSON LIABLE TO PAY..), a person liable to pay the said service charge
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 48(5) and 50 of the Housing Act 1985.
